subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth allows the player to see through the large number of fake walls and floors in the Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote:
This is because of the large number of fake
walls and floors, which can only be seen through with the Lens.

subject: Entrance Tunnel
text: At the entrance, run forward and crawl through the small tunnel to reach the other side.

evidence.quote:
Run forward as you enter, and crawl through the small tunnel to it's other
side.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Drop down the cliff on the other side of the tunnel and defeat the Big Skulltula hanging from the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
Drop down the cliff on the other side, and kill the Big Skulltula hanging from
the ceiling.

subject: Fake Wall
text: At the apparent dead end with a skeleton, walking forward passes right through the fake wall to the other side.

evidence.quote:
You'll reach an apparent
dead end, complete with a charming skeleton to emphasize the fact.  Just walk
forward, and you'll pass right through the wall to the other side.

subject: Reservoir Pits
text: To avoid falling through the numerous fake floors into pits, stay in the shallow water circling the room where no pits appear.

evidence.quote:
To avoid these floors, stay in the shallow water the
circles the room as much as possible.  No pits appear in these tracks.

subject: Lower Room Ladder
text: If you fall into the pits below the Reservoir, collect the Silver Rupees around the cesspool at the bottom of the ladder in the southwest corner to open the door returning upstairs.

evidence.quote:
If you
do happen to fall down one of the pits, then head for the southwest corner of
the large room beneath the Reservoir, climb up the ladder and go through the
door at the top to return to the southwest corner of this room.  You'll need to
gather the Silver Rupees around the cess pool at the bottom of the ladder
before the door will open.

subject: Water Trench
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol painted on the floor drains the water from the trench.

evidence.quote:
After the second corner, run halfway down the hall until you reach a point
where there is a Triforce painted on the floor of the trench.  Stand on this
symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby, and the water in the trench will drain away.

subject: Chest
text: Dropping into the drained pool near the entrance reveals a chest containing bombs and a narrow crawlspace.

evidence.quote:
Drop down into the pit, and you'll find
another narrow crawlspace that Young Link can fit through, and a chest (which
contains bombs... exciting).  Go through the crawlspace.

subject: Dead hand Hallway
text: In the Dead hand Hallway, defeat the Big Skulltula, climb the ivy wall, and go through the door at the other end.

evidence.quote:
Run forward, and kill the Big Skulltula that comes down.  Climb up the ivy-
colored wall to the next level and go through the door on the other end of the
room.

subject: Deadhand
text: Allow one of Deadhand's four hands to grab Link to summon him, break free by rotating the control stick and pressing buttons, then Z-Target his head and execute a Jump Attack when it lowers.

evidence.quote:
Notice the four giant
hands sticking out of the ground in the room.  Run near one, and it will grab
you, summoning Deadhand....Struggle free of the hand holding you by rotating the control
stick and slamming buttons, then Z-Target Deadhand's head.  Stand still (out of
the range of the hands), and wait for Deadhand to get near you, at which point
his head will lower to attack.  Execute a Jump Attack before Deadhand can
attack, and he will begin to run away, eventually sinking back into the ground.
Allow another hand to grab you, and repeat the process until Deadhand dies.

subject: Deadhand Room Chest
text: Defeating Deadhand spawns a chest containing the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Once Deadhand has died, open the chest that appears to find the Lens of Truth.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: Rapidly tapping the assigned C-button to toggle the Lens of Truth on and off allows you to use it without consuming Magic Power.

evidence.quote:
It steadily uses magic while activated, but there's a cool
trick you can use to avoid this: rapidly turn the Lens of Truth on and off by
tapping the assigned c-button, and it won't use any Magic Power.

subject: Hidden Chest
text: Using the Lens of Truth behind the Lens of Truth chest reveals an invisible chest containing a huge rupee.

evidence.quote:
If you like, use the Lens to look behind the chest, and you'll find another,
invisible chest which contains a huge rupee.

subject: East Trench Alcove Chest
text: Climb out of the pit into the drained trench, run left toward the corner, and use the Lens of Truth to reveal an opening on the right containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Climb out of the pit using the ivy on the opposite wall.  From the top of the
pit, run into the trench that was formerly filled with water.  Run to the left
towards the corner, and use the Lens of Truth to see an opening on the right.
Go through it and open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: Big Chest
text: Continuing around the corner in the trench, use the Lens of Truth to locate an opening on the right leading into a room with a large pit and a Big Chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Go back out in the hall
into the trench, and go around the corner.  Use the Lens of Truth to see
another opening on the right, which leads to a room with a chest.  Run into the
room, using the Lens to watch out for the large pit in the floor.  Open the Big
Chest to get the Compass, then return to the trench.

subject: West Trench Alcove Chest
text: Heading back down the trench and taking a left around the corner, use the Lens of Truth to find an opening on the left wall concealing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Go back down the trench in the opposite direction, back around the corner and
to the end of the hall.  Take a left around the corner.  Use the Lens of Truth
to find another opening on the left wall just around the corner.  Go inside to
find another Small Key, then return to the trench.

subject: Reservoir
text: Further down the hall, use the Lens of Truth to spot an opening on the left wall leading to a locked door on the right.

evidence.quote:
Run further down the hall, and use the Lens of Truth halfway down the hall to
see an opening on the left.  Go through it.  Immediately on the other side,
there is a locked door on the right.  Go through it.

subject: Skulltula Room East
text: In Skulltula Room East, defeat four Keese, use the Lens of Truth to see a narrow ledge on the right crossing the pit, and retrieve the Gold Skulltula token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill all four of the Keese in the room, then activate the Lens of Truth.
You'll see a narrow ledge on the right, going around the pit in the center of
the room.  Go along this ledge to the other side, where you will find a Gold
Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang, then return to the
previous room.

subject: Reservoir
text: Reactivating the Lens of Truth in the small prison, run to the right and go through the locked door.

evidence.quote:
Reactivate your Lens of Truth, then run to the right.  On the other side of
this small prison, there is another locked door.  Go through it.

subject: Skulltula Room West
text: In Skulltula Room West, defeat the Deku Baba while avoiding flying pots, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall and collect its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Deku Baba in this room, and watch out for the pots.  They'll hurl
themselves at you, much like the tiles back in the Fire Temple.  Kill the Gold
Skulltula on the wall using the Boomerang and take it's token, then return to
the Reservoir.

subject: Reservoir Pit Chest
text: Follow the hall across from the opening in the wall, drop down the cliff, and open the chest at the bottom of the pit for a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Run down the hall directly across from this opening,
and drop down the cliff at the end of the hall.  Open the chest at the bottom
of the pit to get a Recovery Heart, then climb up the ivy wall.  Go through the
door at the top.

subject: Southwest Coffin
text: In the Coffin Room, defeat the Gibdos, light a Deku Stick at the nearby torch, and ignite the torch next to the southwest coffin to reveal a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Run into the room, and kill the Gibdos to the right.  Gibdos appear as mummies,
but are essentially the same as Redeads.  Once the Gibdos is dead, use the
torch near it to light a Deku Stick.  Run to the southwest corner of the room,
and light the torch next to the coffin in the corner.  The coffin will open,
revealing a Small Key.

subject: Reservoir Alcove
text: In the northeast corner of the Reservoir area, use the Lens of Truth to dodge the pit near the wall and crawl through the crawlspace in the alcove.

evidence.quote:
Run down to the end of this hall, to the northeast corner of the area.
Watch out for the pit near the wall here (use the Lens of Truth to dodge it).
Crawl through the crawlspace in the alcove in the northeast corner.

subject: Tiny Room
text: Exiting the crawlspace into the Tiny Room, go to the right and proceed through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Go to the right and through the locked door as you come out of the crawlspace.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Equip the Hylian Shield instead of the Deku Shield in the Pit Room to prevent Fire Keese from burning the Deku Shield to cinders.

evidence.quote:
Switch to the Hylian Shield if you're on the Deku.
Those Fire Keese can burn it to cinders in one hit.

subject: Pit Room Enemies
text: Use the Boomerang to defeat Fire Keese and Bombs on the Beamos while navigating around hidden pits using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to see the pits in the room, and carefully kill all of
the enemies in the room without falling down.  Use the Boomerang to defeat the
Fire Keese, and a bomb on the Beamos.

subject: Pit Room Corner Chest
text: A chest in the corner of the Pit Room contains a replacement Deku Shield if yours gets burned.

evidence.quote:
If your Deku Shield is burned, then the
chest in the corner contains another one.
